nutrition.title: About nutrition guidance
nutrition.short: Kristina is a fitness trainer, not a nutritionist or dietitian. Meal plans and nutrition guidance are educational support for general fitness, not medical nutrition advice.
nutrition.detail: They do not replace advice from a qualified nutrition professional or doctor. If you have a medical condition, food allergies, or special dietary needs, consult an appropriately qualified professional before making dietary changes.
